title: GLOSA shot (notation 2.0)
description: A storyboard shot directive: the JSON object inside a Fountain note. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved.

prompt.description: The image prompt for this shot. Omitted for a defaults shot.

caption.description: Caption text shown with the rendered panel.

model.description: Identifier of the image model to render with.

seed.description: Random seed: an integer up to 9007199254740991, or a decimal string for larger unsigned 64-bit values.

lora.description: Name or path of a LoRA to apply.

output.description: Output path or name for the rendered image.

preview.description: Render a fast preview instead of a final image.

telemetry.description: Record render telemetry for this shot.
